description: No time-of-day structure was found for OMDB in any source -- the IVAO SOP frames the runway choice entirely around wind component, not the clock (docs/OMDB_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md section 4). This pack therefore uses a single all-day band, the same pattern as YSSY's plan after its curfew mode was removed: the preferred config (30LA30RD) is the baseline preference and the reciprocal config (12LA12RD) stays allowed at all times with a modest preference penalty, reflecting its description in the SOP as the wind-driven fallback rather than a scheduled alternative. Wind can still override this soft preference at any time (soft preference, hard eligibility).
